system:
You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"Helen Stoner, the visitor in black mourning dress with black lace and a thick black veil, seated, her wrist partly bared with faint bruises","action":"Holmes leans forward to push back the black lace frill at her wrist, revealing the marks; she draws her hand back and covers the wrist while Holmes rests his chin on his hands","setting":"Baker Street sitting-room at 221B, overcast winter morning, grey daylight from the window, coal fire crackling in the grate","secondaryElements":"Dr. Watson seated nearby in tweeds, attentive; Holmes in a frock-coat and dressing-gown-free tweeds; a fire screen and hearth glow casting warm light on the figures","mood":"Tense, intimate, restrained and brooding, with a hint of dread beneath dry gaslit calm","timeOfDay":"Morning, overcast grey daylight blending with firelight","composition":"Medium two-shot angled toward the fireplace, Helen in the foreground left, Holmes leaning in center, Watson in the background right, firelight warming the faces"}
